sentences.text: Learned AGP waives service of notice for State.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the reference Court has awarded the compensation exorbitantly ignoring the factors provided in the Land Acquisition Act for assessing the price of the land.
It is a matter of fact whether the compensation has been correctly assessed.
However, the money decree has been passed.
Therefore, a blanket stay could not be granted.

4. In view of the facts and circumstances of the case, there shall be an interim stay to the execution and implementation of the 11-ca-358-2024.odt impugned judgment and award, on the condition to deposit the entire compensation with this Court within twelve (12) weeks from today.
5. If the compensation amount is not deposited within twelve (12) weeks from today, the stay would be vacated automatically.
6. It is made clear that there shall be no further extension of time to deposit the compensation amount.

(S.G. MEHARE, J.) Mujaheed//
